# Box-Cox transform

### 근거

재산피해금액의 range가 넓고, 단위 차이가 많이 나기 때문에 Box-Cox transform을 고려해보았다.

### BOX - COX 결과 (Full model 기준) & R square 기준

```{r}
Box_Cox_R2 <- c()

for(lambda1 in seq(0, 1, by = 0.05)){
  for(lambda2 in seq(-2, 2, by = 0.1)){
    if(lambda1 == 0){
      next
    }
    if(lambda2 == 0){
      data_lambda <- data %>%
        mutate(transform = log(재산피해금액 + lambda1))
    }else{
      data_lambda <- data %>%
        mutate(transform = ((재산피해금액 + lambda1)^lambda2 - 1 )/lambda2)
    }
    
    lm_full_lambda <- lm(transform ~ .-재산피해금액, data = data_lambda)
    
    Box_Cox_R2 <- c(Box_Cox_R2, c(lambda1, lambda2, summary(lm_full_lambda)$r.squared))
  }
}

as.data.frame(t(matrix(Box_Cox_R2, nrow = 3))) %>% 
  rename("lambda1" = "V1", "lambda2" = "V2", "r.squared" = "V3") %>%
  arrange(desc(r.squared)) %>%
  head(5)
```

### Log 변환

Box-Cox에서 lambda2 = 0일 때 시행하는 log 변환에서 best lambda1값이 얼마일 지 찾아보았다.

```{r}
as.data.frame(t(matrix(Box_Cox_R2, nrow = 3))) %>% 
  rename("lambda1" = "V1", "lambda2" = "V2", "r.squared" = "V3") %>%
  filter(lambda2 == 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(r.squared)) %>%
  head(3)
```

### BOX - COX 결과 (Full model 기준) & 1 to 100

```{r}
for(lambda1 in seq(1, 100, by = 1)){
  for(lambda2 in seq(-2, 2, by = 0.1)){
    if(lambda1 == 0){
      next
    }
    if(lambda2 == 0){
      data_lambda <- data %>%
        mutate(transform = log(재산피해금액 + lambda1))
    }else{
      data_lambda <- data %>%
        mutate(transform = ((재산피해금액 + lambda1)^lambda2 - 1 )/lambda2)
    }
    
    lm_full_lambda <- lm(transform ~ .-재산피해금액, data = data_lambda)
    
    Box_Cox_R2 <- c(Box_Cox_R2, c(lambda1, lambda2, summary(lm_full_lambda)$r.squared))
  }
}



as.data.frame(t(matrix(Box_Cox_R2, nrow = 3))) %>% 
  rename("lambda1" = "V1", "lambda2" = "V2", "r.squared" = "V3") %>%
  arrange(desc(r.squared)) %>%
  head(5)
```

### Log 변환

```{r}
as.data.frame(t(matrix(Box_Cox_R2, nrow = 3))) %>% 
  rename("lambda1" = "V1", "lambda2" = "V2", "r.squared" = "V3") %>%
  filter(lambda2 == 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(r.squared)) %>%
  head(3)
```


## Plot both best Box-Cox within best Log

```{r}
q <- data %>%
  mutate(log1_재산피해 = log(재산피해금액 + 1, base = 10), log83_재산피해 = log(재산피해금액 + 83, base = 10)) %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(aes(x = log83_재산피해, y = ..density..), fill = "blue", alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_density(aes(x = log83_재산피해), color = "blue", size = 0.2)+
  geom_histogram(aes(x = log1_재산피해, y = ..density..), fill = "red", alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_density(aes(x = log1_재산피해), color = "red", size = 0.2)+
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("Log transform with 재산피해금액")+
  xlab("log transform value on 재산피해금액")+
  ylab("Density value")+
  labs(subtitle = "red: log(재산피해금액 +1), blue: log(재산피해금액 + 83)")
    

q

ggsave("/Users/donghyunpark/Documents/Seoul National University/3rd year 1st semester/Data mining/1차 프로젝트/1차 프로젝트 Rmd/1차 프로젝트 Visualize/Log transform.png", plot = q, width = 4, height = 2, dpi = 300)
```
